accepted.s: The Union Budget for 2026-27 was presented on which date by Nirmala Sitharaman?
accepted.x: The Union Budget for 2026-27 was presented by Nirmala Sitharaman on 1 February 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the direct date-and-person recall approach.

accepted.s: The Union Budget 2026-27 was described as a:
accepted.x: The 2026-27 Union Budget was billed as a “Yuva Shakti-driven Budget.”
accepted.tq: Identify the exact official description rather than a related slogan.
accepted.sec: Latest Union Budget (2026-27) - priorities, allocations, schemes, fiscal deficit

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly represents the three Kartavyas of the Union Budget 2026-27?
1. Accelerate and sustain growth
2. Fulfil aspirations and build people's capacity
3. Ensure access for every family, community, region and sector
4. Promote complete privatisation of public enterprises
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The three Kartavyas are accelerating and sustaining growth, fulfilling aspirations and building capacity, and ensuring access under Sabka Sath, Sabka Vikas. Complete privatisation is not one of them.
accepted.tq: Find the statement that introduces an unrelated policy objective.
accepted.sec: Latest Union Budget (2026-27) - priorities, allocations, schemes, fiscal deficit

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Union Budget 2026-27:
1. Total expenditure was estimated at ₹53,47,315 crore.
2. Receipts excluding borrowing were estimated at ₹36,51,547 crore.
3. The fiscal deficit was estimated at 4.3 per cent of GDP.
4. The debt was estimated at 45.6 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Expenditure was ₹53,47,315 crore, receipts excluding borrowing were ₹36,51,547 crore and fiscal deficit was 4.3 per cent of GDP. Debt was 55.6 per cent, not 45.6 per cent.
accepted.tq: Split the numerical statements and check the changed digit in the false figure.
accepted.sec: Latest Union Budget (2026-27) - priorities, allocations, schemes, fiscal deficit

accepted.s: What was the estimated capital expenditure in the Union Budget 2026-27?
accepted.x: Capital expenditure in the Union Budget 2026-27 was estimated at ₹12.22 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Use direct numerical recall with nearby budget figures as distractors.
accepted.sec: Latest Union Budget (2026-27) - priorities, allocations, schemes, fiscal deficit

accepted.s: Which scheme replaced MGNREGA in the Union Budget 2026-27?
accepted.x: VB-G RAM G replaced MGNREGA and received an allocation of ₹95,692 crore. MGNREGS had a residual allocation of ₹30,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Use the scheme-replacement relationship as the decisive clue.

accepted.x: VB-G RAM G received the largest allocation among the listed schemes, at ₹95,692 crore.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: PMAY-U received ₹22,025 crore. The allocation of ₹54,917 crore was for PMAY-G.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped allocation within two closely related schemes.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding initiatives announced in the Union Budget 2026-27:
1. Biopharma SHAKTI was allocated ₹10,000 crore.
2. The Electronics Components scheme was allocated ₹40,000 crore.
3. CCUS was allocated ₹20,000 crore.
4. BharatNet and RDI were each allocated ₹20,000 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The allocations were ₹10,000 crore for Biopharma SHAKTI, ₹40,000 crore for Electronics Components, ₹20,000 crore for CCUS, and ₹20,000 crore each for BharatNet and RDI.
accepted.tq: Test a cluster of related allocations through an all-inclusive option.
accepted.sec: Latest Union Budget (2026-27) - priorities, allocations, schemes, fiscal deficit

accepted.s: Rare Earth Corridors were proposed for which group of States?
o: Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu
Odisha, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka
Kerala, Telangana, Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra
West Bengal, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu
accepted.x: The proposed Rare Earth Corridors cover Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete geographical list without substituting neighbouring States.

accepted.s: How many high-speed rail corridors were announced as an initiative in the Union Budget 2026-27?
accepted.x: Seven high-speed rail corridors were announced in the Union Budget 2026-27.
accepted.tq: Use direct count-based recall.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding tax proposals in the Union Budget 2026-27 is correct?
o: The disinvestment target was reduced to ₹20,000 crore.
The new Income-tax Act, 2025 becomes effective from 1 April 2026.
The tax slabs were substantially changed from 1 April 2026.
MAT was increased from 14 per cent to 15 per cent.
accepted.x: The New Income-tax Act, 2025 was to become effective from 1 April 2026. There was no slab change, MAT was reduced from 15 per cent to 14 per cent and the disinvestment target was ₹80,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise true statement among several reversed policy details.
accepted.sec: Latest Union Budget (2026-27) - priorities, allocations, schemes, fiscal deficit

accepted.s:
With reference to the fiscal deficit figures used for budget comparison, consider the following statements:
1. The revised estimate for 2024-25 was 4.8 per cent.
2. The budget estimate for 2025-26 was 4.4 per cent.
3. The revised estimate for 2024-25 was lower than the budget estimate for 2025-26.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The revised estimate for 2024-25 was 4.8 per cent and the budget estimate for 2025-26 was 4.4 per cent. Therefore, statement 3 is false because 4.8 per cent was higher than 4.4 per cent.
accepted.tq: Compare the direction of two nearby fiscal-deficit figures.
accepted.sec: Latest Union Budget (2026-27) - priorities, allocations, schemes, fiscal deficit

accepted.s: Which sequence correctly represents the classification order of receipts in the budget?
o: Tax revenue → Revenue receipts → Capital receipts → Non-tax revenue
Revenue receipts → Tax revenue → Non-tax revenue → Capital receipts
Capital receipts → Revenue receipts → Tax revenue → Non-tax revenue
Non-tax revenue → Tax revenue → Revenue receipts → Capital receipts
accepted.x: The prescribed sequence is Revenue receipts, Tax revenue, Non-tax revenue and Capital receipts.
accepted.tq: Use the first-and-last elements to eliminate incorrect sequences.
accepted.sec: Receipts classification - order and items

accepted.s: Which one of the following is a revenue receipt of the Union Government?
accepted.x: Corporation tax is a tax revenue and therefore a revenue receipt. Recovery of loans and disinvestment are non-debt capital receipts, while market borrowings are debt capital receipts.
accepted.tq: Classify the receipt by asking whether it creates a liability or reduces an asset.
accepted.sec: Receipts classification - order and items

accepted.s: Which of the following is classified as non-tax revenue?
o: Dividends and profits received from PSUs
accepted.x: Dividends and profits from PSUs are non-tax revenue. GST and customs duty are tax revenue, while Treasury bills are debt capital receipts.
accepted.tq: Separate tax revenue, non-tax revenue and debt receipts by their source.
accepted.sec: Receipts classification - order and items

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Receipt)
 a. Market borrowings
 b. Recovery of loans
 c. GST
 d. Fees and fines

List-II (Classification)
 i. Tax revenue
 ii. Non-tax revenue
 iii. Debt capital receipt
 iv. Non-debt capital receipt

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: Market borrowings are debt capital receipts, recovery of loans is a non-debt capital receipt, GST is tax revenue and fees and fines are non-tax revenue.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure classification of GST and then complete the pairs.
accepted.sec: Receipts classification - order and items

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements correctly distinguishes the revenue budget from the capital budget?
1. The revenue budget consists of revenue receipts and revenue expenditure.
2. The capital budget consists of capital receipts and capital expenditure.
3. Borrowings and disinvestment are associated with the capital budget.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The revenue budget covers revenue receipts and expenditure, whereas the capital budget covers capital receipts and expenditure, including borrowings and disinvestment.
accepted.tq: Check whether each statement fits the corresponding budget account.
accepted.sec: Receipts classification - order and items

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with its budget-account characteristic?
o: Capital account — current-year routine transactions only
Capital account — no transactions involving liabilities
Revenue account — creation of long-term assets only
accepted.x: The revenue account records current-year transactions, while the capital account relates to assets and liabilities.
accepted.tq: Use the running-versus-asset-creation distinction to reject reversed descriptions.
accepted.sec: Receipts classification - order and items

accepted.s: Which of the following is an example of capital expenditure?
accepted.x: Capital expenditure creates assets or provides loans, such as construction of roads, defence equipment and loans to States. Salaries, pensions, subsidies and interest are revenue expenditure.
accepted.tq: Apply the asset-creation test to the expenditure item.
accepted.sec: Receipts classification - order and items

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Wealth tax, gift tax and estate duty were described as paper taxes because they never generated large revenue and are now abolished. GST is not a paper tax.
accepted.tq: Find the item outside the stated group rather than the abolished examples.
accepted.sec: Receipts classification - order and items

accepted.s:
Consider the following events:
A. Railway Budget merged with the Union Budget
B. Separate Railway Budget introduced
C. Budget presentation date shifted to 1 February
D. Plan and non-plan distinction removed
Which one of the following is the correct chronological order?
accepted.x: The separate Railway Budget began in 1924, its merger occurred in 2017, the presentation date shifted to 1 February in 2017, and the plan/non-plan distinction was removed in 2017-18.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest event first and then distinguish the 2017 reforms.
accepted.sec: Budget history and reforms - first budget, Railway merger, 1 February, plan/non-plan

accepted.s: The separate Railway Budget was introduced in 1924 on the recommendation of the:
accepted.x: The separate Railway Budget began in 1924 following the recommendations of the Acworth Committee constituted in 1921.
accepted.tq: Match the reform with the committee that recommended it.
accepted.sec: Budget history and reforms - first budget, Railway merger, 1 February, plan/non-plan

accepted.s: From 2017, the Union Budget presentation date was shifted from the last working day of February to:
accepted.x: From 2017, the Union Budget was presented on 1 February instead of the last working day of February.
accepted.tq: Test the exact date change rather than the month alone.
accepted.sec: Budget history and reforms - first budget, Railway merger, 1 February, plan/non-plan

accepted.s: The distinction between plan and non-plan expenditure was removed in 2017-18 on the recommendation of the:
accepted.x: The plan/non-plan distinction was removed in 2017-18 following the recommendation of the Expenditure Management Commission.
accepted.tq: Use the committee-function association and avoid swapping reform bodies.
accepted.sec: Budget history and reforms - first budget, Railway merger, 1 February, plan/non-plan

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements is correct?
1. Morarji Desai presented the largest number of Union Budgets.
2. The 1973-74 Budget was known as the Black Budget.
3. The 1997-98 Budget was known as the Dream Budget.
4. Nirmala Sitharaman has presented every Budget since 2019.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Morarji Desai presented 10 budgets; 1973-74 was the Black Budget, 1997-98 was the Dream Budget, and Nirmala Sitharaman has presented every Budget since 2019.
accepted.tq: Verify each historical label and office-holder fact before selecting the inclusive option.

accepted.s: The term “Budget” is derived from the French word “bougette”, which means:
accepted.x: The word Budget is derived from the French word “bougette”, meaning “little bag”.
accepted.tq: Test the exact etymological meaning rather than a related financial term.
accepted.sec: Budget history and reforms - first budget, Railway merger, 1 February, plan/non-plan

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding budget traditions is correct?
o: Printing of the Budget begins with the Halwa ceremony at North Block.
The word Budget is expressly mentioned in the Constitution.
The Budget was paperless from the first year of the Republic.
The Halwa ceremony is held after the Budget is presented in Parliament.
accepted.x: The word “Budget” is not in the Constitution, and printing traditionally begins with the Halwa ceremony at North Block.
accepted.tq: Use the exact institutional detail and reject absolute historical claims.
